findings.summary: onlyAttestationArtifacts takes line.slice(3) as the path. For a rename or copy entry in git status --porcelain ('R  .ai-sdlc/reviews/x.json -> src/a.ts') that string starts with '.ai-sdlc/reviews/', so a rename from an artifact path into source counts as clean and rebase-push then runs rebase --autostash. Impact is low: only HEAD is pushed and the stash comes back after the rebase. Suggestion: split on ' -> ' and require both sides to be artifact paths (or use --porcelain -z).
